craftingStations.comment: The grain mills open the crafting menu on AldCraftingGrainMill, where a Sea Salt Rock refines into Salt Pile (smithing.newRecipes). The vanilla GrainMill is listed; add the editor id of any mod grain mill the farms use (xEdit: FURN whose FULL contains Grain Mill). A mill listed here opens the crafting menu; whether its push idle still plays first is to be confirmed in game.

benchMoves.comment: Immersive Armors puts its Apotheus set on the Skyforge; the Skyforge keeps only the three sets below

world.comment: AlduinakWorldChanges.esp (9776cba3), merged as spec data. Its Creation Kit dropped the Warbirds Whiterun Metropolis.esp master and rewrote every cell it opened, so only the references are carried: the new ones here, the nudges under "moves", and one disable under "disableReferences". The section is plain data, edited by hand.

list.name: College of Winterhold or the Synod

disableReferences.comment: The beehives and Stonewall Terrace pieces the owner asked Graves to delete, and the collision box left in the gateway of the iron gate in the Whiterun outer wall. A Creation Kit deletion does not survive a rebuild, so they are listed here and come back Initially Disabled every run.

overrides.comment: Single fields of records other plugins define, overridden in place: misc sets an item's weight by form key (the Sea Salt Rock of Saltdeposits.esp, 20 instead of 1), recipes sets a recipe's created object count (one Sea Salt Rock refines into 50 Salt Pile at the smelter), refs sets the scale of one of the plugin's own placed references by editor id (the mead benches, whose pick target was too small). foods swaps one magic effect of a food by form key, from and hunger by editor id (the six raw vegetables get Survival's Small hunger effect, the one it gives raw apples and tomatoes, instead of Very Small). quests drops the named scripts from a quest by form key (Survival_MainScript, whose 5 s OnUpdate poll of Survival_ModeToggle starts vanilla Survival once the client sets the toggle for the HUD). Runs in the hotfix list too.

recipes.name: Salt Pile from a Sea Salt Rock

disableActors.comment: Every placed actor, living or dead, of every plugin before this one is Initially Disabled, and one with an enable parent gets the player as parent, opposite, so no quest or marker turns it back on. The server spawns none of them; the game would. except names actors to leave alone, by form key. A worldspace override added for their cells takes the fields of its last winner outside notFrom: DynDOLOD.esm is generated, and its own large references would make it a master.

races.comment: The playable races and their vampire forms lose every racial power the game hands a character (greater powers and the vampires' Hunter's Sight); only Khajiit Night Eye stays. passives sets what the owner's list changes (starting attributes, unarmed damage read from a weapon at run time, abilities removed), descriptions is the race menu text, spells the magnitudes of a racial ability. Dunmer, Nord and Redguard already match the list; Argonians drop to the common unarmed damage of 4, and Khajiit lose the client-only claws ability so their unarmed damage is the race's alone.

descriptions.ArgonianRace: The reptilian people of Black Marsh, at home in its swamps and bayous. Argonians breathe underwater and resist 50% of disease.
descriptions.BretonRace: The people of High Rock, of mixed human and elven blood, with a natural gift for the arcane. Bretons have 25 more Magicka.
descriptions.DarkElfRace: The Dunmer of Morrowind, a proud and hardy people shaped by an ashen homeland. Dark Elves resist 50% of fire damage.
descriptions.HighElfRace: The Altmer of the Summerset Isles, long-lived and steeped in magic. High Elves have 50 more Magicka.
descriptions.ImperialRace: The people of Cyrodiil, heart of the Empire, known for their discipline, trade and industry. Imperials spend 25% less fatigue on their professions.
descriptions.KhajiitRace: The cat-folk of Elsweyr, quick and keen-eyed. A Khajiit's claws strike as hard as a steel dagger, and Night Eye lets them see in the dark.
descriptions.NordRace: The tall, fair-haired people of Skyrim, hardened by its long winters. Nords resist 50% of frost damage.
descriptions.OrcRace: The Orsimer of Wrothgar and the mountain strongholds, famed as warriors and smiths. Orcs have 50 more Stamina.
descriptions.RedguardRace: The people of Hammerfell, the most naturally gifted warriors in Tamriel. Redguards resist 50% of poison.
descriptions.WoodElfRace: The Bosmer of Valenwood, nimble woodland hunters. Wood Elves resist 25% of poison and 25% of disease.

craftingCategories.comment: The CraftingCategories SKSE plugin puts an item in one section and one category of that section, by keywords on the item. Every armour, weapon and ammunition the benches make gets the keyword of the first section it fits (a slot, the shields, the weapons, anything else worn) and one category keyword: its race when a racial rule gates the recipe, otherwise the material its recipes use most of (materials in order, a tie going to the earlier one; ignoreItems never count). The run writes the json the plugin reads.
